artboards.title: B · One set at a time

annotations.text:
THE SYSTEM

Type — Archivo (display / UI), IBM Plex Mono (all numerals, micro-labels). Tabular digits are why the set columns finally line up.

Ground — #09090B page, #131316 card, #1C1C21 raised, #232328 hairline. Three real surface steps instead of one flat card colour.

Accent — #CCFF33 only for live, done, or the one primary action on screen. Nothing decorative is lime.

Radii — 8 / 12-14 / pill. Tighter than the current 1rem so the numbers read as instruments, not bubbles.

What changed structurally:
1. Headers shrank from ~90px of title+subtitle to a 34px line.
2. Cards-inside-cards became hairline-separated full-bleed rows.
3. Records came out of a tab and onto the exercise screen.
4. Set logging got a spine, a focused current set, and a rest timer that docks instead of interrupting.
This one is live — tick a set to see the row commit and the rest timer dock in. "Add set" works too. Rest length is a tweak above the frame.
Two other ways the logging screen could go, if the committed direction on page 1 isn't the one. Both are deliberately rough — they're here to pick an idea from, not a look.
